Any alternatives to Instant Replay? (Nvidia shadow play)
So I’ve been using shadowplay for years to get clips without manually recording every time I get on but my instant replay feature when using the game overlay hasn’t been working for a while, I will enable it but it will turn off immediately, I’ve tried everything from reinstalling drivers, reinstalling GeForce experience, making sure I have enough space, making sure I don’t have any streaming service on, to fully resetting my pc to factory settings, it’s honestly really frustrating that even formatting my laptop didn’t do anything, baffled by that, I’ve tried using Xbox game bar but it also doesn’t work, it only captures audio and not video, I was told the game needs to be windowed or borderless but that also does not work, I give him on both programs, looking for any alternatives ?
